articles.title: Race Course Walker’s Botanical Boulevard Upgraded with Sensor-Driven Smart Solar Illumination
articles.author: Urban Civic Desk
articles.videoTitle: Race Course Night View: Smart Solar Lighting Live
articles.excerpt: CCMC installs 120 motion-sensing LED pillars, emergency SOS kiosks, and heritage fountains across the iconic 2.5 km running loop.
articles.content: Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation completes the smart botanical promenade modernization along Race Course Road, featuring intelligent solar-powered night lighting, dedicated pedestrian hydration stations, and continuous CCTV surveillance.

articles.title: The Quiet Revolution in Kovai’s EV Corridor: How 400+ Local MSMEs Power India’s Electric Transition
articles.author: Kovai Urban Bureau
articles.videoTitle: Coimbatore EV Component Park & Cleanroom Walkthrough
articles.excerpt: From precision motor stator windings in Peelamedu to smart battery thermal management modules in Sulur, Coimbatore’s deep-rooted precision engineering heritage is quietly positioning the city as India’s premier electric mobility hub.
articles.content: Coimbatore MSMEs have successfully pivoted towards electric vehicle components with over 400 specialized manufacturing facilities supplying to major automotive OEMs across India.

articles.title: Avinashi Road 10.1 km Elevated Flyover Crosses 80% Milestone: Final Spans Launched
articles.author: Infra Bureau
articles.videoTitle: Avinashi Road Elevated Corridor Drone Fly-Through
articles.excerpt: With 284 out of 306 spans successfully launched, the corridor from Uppilipalayam to Goldwins enters its final surfacing phase.
articles.content: State highways engineers confirm completion of 80% deck construction along the 10.1 km elevated expressway.

articles.title: Siruvani Reservoir Storage at 45.4 ft: Summer Water Rationing Prevented
articles.author: Water Resources Desk
articles.videoTitle: Siruvani Reservoir Water Level & Supply Inspection
articles.excerpt: Full supply capacity of 86 MLD maintained for West and Central zones as Pilloor-III distribution testing wraps up.
articles.content: Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation confirms uninterrupted drinking water supply following robust seasonal storage levels.

articles.title: CODISSIA Intec 2026: 450+ Global Automation & Robotics Exhibitors Finalize Arena
articles.author: Industrial Bureau
articles.excerpt: South India’s premier industrial expo introduces a dedicated pavilion for precision EV motor stamping and aerospace titanium tooling.
articles.content: International trade delegations from Germany, Japan, and Taiwan arrive for the flagship biennial industrial trade fair.

articles.title: Coimbatore Metro Rail Phase-1 DPR Approved by Union Ministry with ₹10,740 Cr Outlay
articles.author: Transit Correspondent
articles.videoTitle: Coimbatore Metro Alignment Map & Corridor 1 & 2 Blueprint
articles.excerpt: Dual-corridor network spanning 44 km from Collectorate to Bilichi and Karanampettai gets center clearance.
articles.content: Chennai Metro Rail Limited initiates preliminary land acquisition and utility diversion works along Avinashi Road.

articles.title: TIDEL Park Phase-2 at Avinashi Road Reaches 90% Pre-Lease Occupancy Across Tech Towers
articles.author: Tech Bureau
articles.videoTitle: TIDEL Park Phase-2 Construction Aerial Tour
articles.excerpt: Five Fortune-500 SaaS and engineering R&D hubs book 8.5 lakh sq.ft of Grade-A office space adjacent to ELCOT IT SEZ.
articles.content: State infrastructure corporation confirms on-schedule handover of IT tower suites in Q3 2026.

articles.title: Sridhar Vembu: How Coimbatore & Rural Tech Hubs Power Global Enterprise SaaS
articles.author: Executive Bureau
articles.videoTitle: Sridhar Vembu Keynote on Rural Technology Clusters
articles.excerpt: Coimbatore’s rich engineering DNA and grounding prove that global enterprise software can thrive sustainably without big-city burnout.
articles.content: Zoho founder explores deep-tech decentralization and engineering talent retention in Tamil Nadu tier-2 centers.

articles.title: 14th Annual Coimbatore Marathon Crosses 18,000 Runners for Cancer Awareness
articles.author: Sports Desk
articles.excerpt: Coimbatore Cancer Foundation announces certified 5K, 10K, and 21K half-marathon circuits with medical support stations.
articles.content: Over 18,000 participants register for the annual Kovai marathon raising crucial awareness and community cancer care funds.

articles.title: PSG Tech & Coimbatore Innovation Hub Launch ₹25 Cr Deep-Tech Collegiate Accelerator Fund
articles.author: Academic Cell
articles.videoTitle: PSG Tech DeepTech Lab Demo Day
articles.excerpt: Collegiate entrepreneurs receive seed funding and lab infrastructure for precision agriculture robotics and healthcare AI diagnostics.
articles.content: New innovation endowment supports 20 student-led research spin-offs across biomedical and robotics disciplines.

articles.title: Kovai Food Carnival 2026: 60+ Authentic Kongu Delicacies at VOC Grounds
articles.author: Culture Desk
articles.videoTitle: Kovai Food Carnival Stalls & Kongu Cuisine Preview
articles.excerpt: Featuring traditional Kongu non-veg curries, Pallipalayam specialties, and traditional millet desserts across 60 curated stalls.
articles.content: Three-day cultural festival attracts thousands of food enthusiasts celebrating indigenous Kongu culinary heritage.

articles.title: Todays Coimbatore Daily e-Paper Edition: Full Digital Newspaper Replica
articles.author: Editorial Board
articles.excerpt: Access high-resolution PDF pages, editorial columns, classifieds, and district pullouts in the official digital paper format.
articles.content: Complete daily district edition covering civic infrastructure, textile markets, commerce, and civic announcements.

articles.title: Coimbatore International Airport Expansion: ₹2,000 Cr Runway & New Integrated Terminal Tender Awarded
articles.author: Aviation Desk
articles.excerpt: Land acquisition for 627 acres wraps up as Airport Authority of India finalizes global EPC bids for the 12,500 ft wide-body runway extension.
articles.content: The expansion will enable direct long-haul international flights connecting Coimbatore to Europe, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East.

articles.title: Western Ring Road Phase-1 Crosses 65% Physical Progress: Kuniyamuthur to Madukkarai Stretch Nears Completion
articles.author: Highways Bureau
articles.excerpt: The 32.4 km four-lane bypass corridor will divert over 25,000 heavy commercial vehicles daily away from Coimbatore core city roads.
articles.content: State Highways Department confirms scheduled opening of Phase-1 before the upcoming monsoon season.

articles.title: Coimbatore Corporation Smart City Lakefronts at Valankulam & Kurichi Draw Record 85,000 Weekend Visitors
articles.author: Civic Reporter
articles.excerpt: Illuminated floating fountains, open-air food kiosks, and eco-cycling tracks transform Kovai’s historic lake system into prime leisure hubs.
articles.content: Municipal authorities announce expanded weekend cultural programming and battery-operated shuttle services around lake perimeters.

articles.title: Coimbatore Junction Railway Station Redevelopment to Feature Multi-Modal Transit Hub & Airport-Style Concourse
articles.author: Transit Correspondent
articles.excerpt: Southern Railway finalizes ₹450 Cr world-class station revamp with elevated roof plaza, segregated arrival/departure gates, and 1,200-car multi-level parking.
articles.content: Construction crews begin platform canopy modernization and passenger skywalk connections to the nearby central bus terminal.

articles.title: VOC Park & Mini Zoo Modernization: ₹45 Cr Bio-Park & Botanical Conservatory DPR Finalized
articles.author: Environment Desk
articles.excerpt: New eco-friendly masterplan introduces native Western Ghats flora pavilions, interactive science exhibits, and underground stormwater harvesting.
articles.content: Coimbatore Corporation Council approves immediate execution of Phase-1 landscaping and heritage tree preservation.

articles.title: Coimbatore District Health Department Deploys 24 Mobile Medical Screening Vans Across Rural Kongu Panchayats
articles.author: Health Correspondent
articles.excerpt: Equipped with digital ECG, ultrasound diagnostics, and tele-consultation suites, the fleet delivers primary healthcare to 120+ village centers.
articles.content: District Collector flags off the state-of-the-art mobile medical units aimed at early non-communicable disease detection.
